kpis.name: Total AUM
kpis.dbQuery:
SELECT SUM(p.amount) AS total_aum
FROM wealth_pulse.gold.positions p
JOIN wealth_pulse.gold.financial_account a
    ON p.financial_account_id = a.financial_account_id
WHERE p.snapshot_date = (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot_date)
    FROM wealth_pulse.gold.positions
)
  AND a.account_status_indicator = 'O'
  AND a.is_active = 1

kpis.name: Net New Assets (QTD)
kpis.dbQuery:
WITH latest_snapshot AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(snapshot_date) AS end_date
    FROM wealth_pulse.gold.positions
),
date_filter AS (
    SELECT
        end_date,
        DATE_TRUNC('quarter', end_date) AS start_date
    FROM latest_snapshot
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.transaction_code IN ('CONTRIBUTION', 'TRANSFER_IN', 'RFF', 'CSR')
                THEN ABS(t.amount)
                ELSE 0
            END
        )
        -
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.transaction_code IN ('DISTRIBUTION', 'TRANSFER_OUT', 'SFF', 'PCC')
                THEN ABS(t.amount)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ),
        2
    ) AS net_new_assets
FROM wealth_pulse.gold.transactions t
JOIN wealth_pulse.gold.financial_account fa
    ON t.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id
WHERE CAST(t.transaction_date AS DATE)
      BETWEEN (SELECT start_date FROM date_filter)
          AND (SELECT end_date FROM date_filter)
  AND fa.account_status_indicator = 'O'
  AND fa.is_active = 1;

kpis.name: Idle Cash
kpis.dbQuery:
WITH latest_snapshot AS (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) AS max_snapshot_date
    FROM wealth_pulse.gold.positions
),
position_mv AS (
    SELECT
        p.financial_account_id,
        SUM(p.amount) AS market_value
    FROM wealth_pulse.gold.positions p
    JOIN wealth_pulse.gold.financial_account a
        ON p.financial_account_id = a.financial_account_id
    CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot l
    WHERE p.snapshot_date = l.max_snapshot_date
      AND a.account_status_indicator = 'O'
      AND a.is_active = 1
    GROUP BY
        p.financial_account_id
),
account_cash AS (
    SELECT
        hd.house_hold_name,
        a.financial_account_id,
        mv.market_value,
        a.cash_available,
        a.cash_available / NULLIF(mv.market_value,0) AS cash_pct
    FROM wealth_pulse.gold.account_summary a
    JOIN position_mv mv
        ON a.financial_account_id = mv.financial_account_id
    LEFT JOIN wealth_pulse.gold.household_details hd
        ON a.financial_account_id = hd.financial_account_id
    JOIN wealth_pulse.gold.financial_account fa
        ON a.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id
    WHERE fa.account_status_indicator = 'O'
      AND fa.is_active = 1
)
SELECT
 ROUND(SUM(cash_available),2) AS idle_cash
FROM account_cash
WHERE cash_pct > 0.05

kpis.name: Concentration Risk
kpis.dbQuery:
WITH latest_snapshot AS (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) AS snapshot_date
    FROM wealth_pulse.gold.positions
),
holdings AS (
    SELECT
        UPPER(
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(TRIM(s.ticker), ''),
                NULLIF(TRIM(p.cusip), '')
            )
        ) AS position_key,
        SUM(p.amount) AS market_value
    FROM wealth_pulse.gold.positions p
    JOIN wealth_pulse.gold.household_details hd
        ON p.financial_account_id = hd.financial_account_id
    JOIN wealth_pulse.gold.financial_account fa
        ON p.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id
    LEFT JOIN wealth_pulse.gold.securities s
        ON p.cusip = s.cusip
    WHERE p.snapshot_date = (
            SELECT snapshot_date
            FROM latest_snapshot
        )
      AND fa.account_status_indicator = 'O'
      AND fa.is_active = 1
    GROUP BY
        UPPER(
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(TRIM(s.ticker), ''),
                NULLIF(TRIM(p.cusip), '')
            )
        )
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        MAX(market_value) * 100.0 /
        NULLIF(SUM(market_value), 0),
        2
    ) AS max_concentration_pct
FROM holdings;

kpis.name: Cash Drag (bps)
kpis.dbQuery:
WITH latest_snapshot AS (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) AS snapshot_date
    FROM wealth_pulse.gold.positions
),
account_mv AS (
    SELECT
        p.financial_account_id,
        SUM(p.amount) AS market_value
    FROM wealth_pulse.gold.positions p
    CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot l
    WHERE p.snapshot_date = l.snapshot_date
    GROUP BY p.financial_account_id
),
acct_cash AS (
    SELECT
        a.financial_account_id,
        a.account_number,
        a.cash_available,
        mv.market_value,
        a.cash_available / NULLIF(mv.market_value, 0) AS cash_pct
    FROM wealth_pulse.gold.account_summary a
    JOIN account_mv mv
        ON a.financial_account_id = mv.financial_account_id
    JOIN wealth_pulse.gold.financial_account fa
        ON a.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id
    WHERE fa.account_status_indicator = 'O'
      AND fa.is_active = 1
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        (AVG(cash_pct) - 0.03)
        * (0.10 - 0.045)
        * 10000,
        2
    ) AS cash_drag_bps
FROM acct_cash
WHERE cash_pct > 0.03
